psalm-35-1.verse: Contend, O Lord, with those who contend with me; Fight against those who fight against me.
psalm-35-1.prayer: Lord, fight for me when I face battles beyond my strength. Be my defender and help me trust You completely.

psalm-35-2.verse: Take hold of buckler and shield And rise up for my help.
psalm-35-2.prayer: Father, thank You for being my shield and protection. Strengthen me when I feel vulnerable or afraid.

psalm-35-3.verse: Draw also the spear and the battle-axe to meet those who pursue me; Say to my soul, “I am your salvation.”
psalm-35-3.prayer: Lord, remind my soul that You are my salvation. Fill my heart with confidence in Your deliverance and care.

psalm-35-4.verse: Let those be ashamed and dishonored who seek my life; Let those be turned back and humiliated who devise evil against me.
psalm-35-4.prayer: Father, frustrate every plan that seeks to harm me spiritually and draw me away from Your will.

psalm-35-5.verse: Let them be like chaff before the wind, With the angel of the Lord driving them on.
psalm-35-5.prayer: Lord, remove obstacles placed by the enemy and lead me securely in the path You have prepared.

psalm-35-6.verse: Let their way be dark and slippery, With the angel of the Lord pursuing them.
psalm-35-6.prayer: Father, guide me through difficult and uncertain seasons. Let Your light direct my steps.

psalm-35-7.verse: For without cause they hid their net for me; Without cause they dug a pit for my soul.
psalm-35-7.prayer: Lord, protect me from hidden traps, temptations, and dangers that I cannot see.

psalm-35-8.verse: Let destruction come upon him unawares, And let the net which he hid catch himself; Into that very destruction let him fall.
psalm-35-8.prayer: Father, I trust Your justice. Help me place every wrong and every hurt into Your hands.

psalm-35-9.verse: And my soul shall rejoice in the Lord; It shall exult in His salvation.
psalm-35-9.prayer: Lord, let my soul rejoice in Your salvation and celebrate the victories You bring into my life.

psalm-35-10.verse: All my bones will say, “Lord, who is like You, Who delivers the afflicted from him who is too strong for him, And the afflicted and the needy from him who robs him?”
psalm-35-10.prayer: Father, thank You for rescuing the weak, the needy, and those who trust in You. Help me remember Your faithfulness.

psalm-35-11.verse: Malicious witnesses rise up; They ask me of things that I do not know.
psalm-35-11.prayer: Lord, when others misunderstand or falsely accuse me, help me respond with wisdom, grace, and integrity.

psalm-35-12.verse: They repay me evil for good, To the bereavement of my soul.
psalm-35-12.prayer: Father, when I experience disappointment or betrayal, comfort my heart and remind me that You never fail.

psalm-35-13.verse: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth; I humbled my soul with fasting, And my prayer kept returning to my bosom.
psalm-35-13.prayer: Lord, teach me to pray for others, even those who may oppose or hurt me. Help me reflect Your mercy.

psalm-35-14.verse: I went about as though it were my friend or brother; I bowed down mourning, as one who sorrows for a mother.
psalm-35-14.prayer: Father, give me a compassionate heart that genuinely cares for others and seeks their good.

psalm-35-15.verse: But at my stumbling they rejoiced and gathered themselves together; The smiters whom I did not know gathered together against me, They slandered me without ceasing.
psalm-35-15.prayer: Lord, when I feel rejected or mocked, help me find my identity and security in You alone.

psalm-35-16.verse: Like godless jesters at a feast, They gnashed at me with their teeth.
psalm-35-16.prayer: Father, guard my heart from bitterness. Teach me to forgive and trust You with every injustice.

psalm-35-17.verse: Lord, how long will You look on? Rescue my soul from their ravages, My only life from the lions.
psalm-35-17.prayer: Lord, rescue me from discouragement and despair. Renew my strength and restore my hope in You.

psalm-35-18.verse: I will give You thanks in the great congregation; I will praise You among a mighty throng.
psalm-35-18.prayer: Father, I will give thanks to You publicly and praise You for Your faithfulness in my life.

psalm-35-19.verse: Do not let those who are wrongfully my enemies rejoice over me; Nor let those who hate me without cause wink maliciously.
psalm-35-19.prayer: Lord, protect me from those who rejoice in wrongdoing. Help me remain faithful to truth and righteousness.

psalm-35-20.verse: For they do not speak peace, But they devise deceitful words against those who are quiet in the land.
psalm-35-20.prayer: Father, let peace, truth, and integrity guide my relationships and conversations.

psalm-35-21.verse: They opened their mouth wide against me; They said, “Aha, aha, our eyes have seen it!”
psalm-35-21.prayer: Lord, when others speak against me, help me trust that You know the truth and see every situation clearly.

psalm-35-22.verse: You have seen it, O Lord, do not keep silent; O Lord, do not be far from me.
psalm-35-22.prayer: Father, thank You that You see my struggles and understand every challenge I face.

psalm-35-23.verse: Stir up Yourself, and awake to my right And to my cause, my God and my Lord.
psalm-35-23.prayer: Lord, arise and defend me according to Your perfect wisdom and justice.

psalm-35-24.verse: Judge me, O Lord my God, according to Your righteousness, And do not let them rejoice over me.
psalm-35-24.prayer: Father, judge righteously and help me trust Your timing in every circumstance.

psalm-35-25.verse: Do not let them say in their heart, “Aha, our desire!” Do not let them say, “We have swallowed him up!”
psalm-35-25.prayer: Lord, do not allow fear or discouragement to gain victory in my life. Strengthen my faith in You.

psalm-35-26.verse: Let those be ashamed and humiliated altogether who rejoice at my distress; Let those be clothed with shame and dishonor who magnify themselves over me.
psalm-35-26.prayer: Father, bring humility where there is pride and establish righteousness where there is wrongdoing.

psalm-35-27.verse: Let them shout for joy and rejoice, who favor my vindication; And let them say continually, “The Lord be magnified, Who delights in the prosperity of His servant.”
psalm-35-27.prayer: Lord, let those who love You rejoice in Your goodness. Fill my heart with gratitude and praise.

psalm-35-28.verse: And my tongue shall declare Your righteousness And Your praise all day long.
psalm-35-28.prayer: Father, may my tongue continually speak of Your righteousness and declare Your praise throughout the day.

psalm-35-closing.verse:
Lord, thank You for being my defender, protector, and source of strength. When I face difficulties, misunderstandings, or spiritual battles, help me trust You completely. Guard my heart from fear, bitterness, and discouragement. Fill me with compassion, faith, and confidence in Your justice. May my life continually praise You and testify to Your faithfulness, goodness, and salvation.

In Jesus’ name, Amen. 🙏🏻
